description: This Mendeley Data archive contains the companion data published by Zeyu Xia and Sibo Cheng for the PyTorchFire wildfire simulator. Version 1 lists a 90.2 MB HDF5 dataset, a prediction-time CSV and folders labelled real, simulated_fig and simulated_tbl. The authors relate the archive to LANDFIRE, an ERA5-Land dataset and the archived software release. It is intended to support reuse and assessment of the simulator, including comparisons of wildfire behaviour and computational performance. The public landing page provides file access free under CC BY 4.0 and records publication on 31 July 2024. The author describes regional examples from the 2017 Pier and 2020 Bear fires in California. Regional scope is inferred from those documented uses; exact archive bounds, grid resolution and full period remain unverified. That sparse metadata is a limitation for selecting a particular event or region without inspecting the files and accompanying code. PyTorchFire is a separate G5 draft; no directly related existing catalogue record was established for this derived bundle. Only metadata and the visible file listing were inspected.

schema_summary: HDF5 and CSV. Own real.py expects vegetation, density, wind, slope, ignition and target arrays; archive-wide schema is not verified.
